questions.stem: Which historically famous physicist fundamentally formulated the Universal Law of Gravitation, proposing that every mass in the universe directly attracts every other mass?

options.option_text: Albert Einstein
Isaac Newton
Galileo Galilei
Johannes Kepler

questions.explanation: Sir Isaac Newton formulated the Universal Law of Gravitation in 1687. It states that every particle attracts every other particle in the universe with a force directly proportional to the product of their masses and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them.
